feedPosts.title: Inauguration of Advanced AI & Cloud Computing Research Lab
feedPosts.content: Maharaja Institute of Technology, Mysore proudly inaugurates the state-of-the-art Advanced Artificial Intelligence & High-Performance Cloud Computing Center in the ISE block. The facility is equipped to support faculty research, sponsored projects, and student innovation.

comments.text: A tremendous milestone for our department and students!

feedPosts.title: Project Presentation & Review: Faculty Portfolio Management System (FPMS)
feedPosts.content: Mentored student team Thanushree S [4MH23IS109], Vijith Kumar R N [4MH23IS119], and Vikas U S [4MH23IS120] presented their institutional web application architecture for automated accreditation documentation, mentor allocation, and portfolio auditing before the academic committee.

feedPosts.title: Two-Day National Workshop on Microservices and DevOps Deployments
feedPosts.content: Department of Information Science and Engineering invites faculty, researchers, and students to the hands-on National Workshop on Kubernetes, Docker, and Continuous Delivery pipelines on November 14-15, 2026.
